The SATS Protocol.name: Lisa
The SATS Protocol.text: I’d tried the nightly visualization thing before and always ended up forcing it. This guide gave me one short scene and a simple routine to return to. A few weeks in, money showed up that I wasn’t expecting, and the bigger change was how I see myself. I stopped waiting for things to happen to me.

The SATS Protocol.name: Frank
The SATS Protocol.text: Clear, practical, no fluff. The troubleshooting section fixed the exact problems I kept running into with distraction and trying too hard. Unexpected money came my way while I was doing the work, and I carry myself differently now. That part matters more to me.

The SATS Protocol.name: Ray Z.
The SATS Protocol.text: I was skeptical and I’m still a practical guy. But I followed the seven nights as written and something shifted. Money came in out of nowhere, and my idea of who I am got a lot bigger. Worth far more than $27.

Self-Concept Reset Guide.name: Josh
Self-Concept Reset Guide.text: The exercise on naming the old description of yourself hit hard. I’d been repeating the same story about myself for years without noticing. Once I changed it, unexpected money came in and my whole outlook reset. This guide is the reason.

Self-Concept Reset Guide.name: Melissa R.
Self-Concept Reset Guide.text: I did the seven days and kept going with the thirty-day framework. My self-image feels completely different now, steadier and more sure of myself. Money I didn’t see coming showed up along the way. I’m grateful I found this.

Self-Concept Reset Guide.name: Michelle W.
Self-Concept Reset Guide.text: This is a workbook, and you actually have to do the work, which is why it works. I stopped talking to myself the old way. Within weeks I had a renewed sense of who I am, and an unexpected payment landed too. I recommend it to anyone ready to do it.

Money & Self-Concept Guide.name: Jennifer F.
Money & Self-Concept Guide.text: What I liked most is that it separates the facts of your money situation from the story you tell about it. That alone changed how I handled things. I felt like a different person around money, and then unexpected money came in. I’m still using the weekly review.

Money & Self-Concept Guide.name: Sandra L.
Money & Self-Concept Guide.text: Grounded and honest. It never promises anything, it just gives you real exercises. I came out of it with a renewed self-concept, and money came in that I hadn’t planned on. Best $37 I’ve spent on myself.

Money & Self-Concept Guide.name: Rhonda K.
Money & Self-Concept Guide.text: I didn’t realize how many of my money habits were just old beliefs. Working through this guide, my confidence came back, and so did unexpected money. I feel like myself again, only stronger.

30-Day Assumption Workbook.name: Gina F.
30-Day Assumption Workbook.text: Having a specific exercise each day is what kept me going. By the end of the thirty days my self-concept had completely renewed, and unexpected money came in too. I finally finished something and it changed me.

30-Day Assumption Workbook.name: Bobby T.
30-Day Assumption Workbook.text: I’d read the books but never stuck with the practice. This workbook gave me structure and I stayed with it. I’m a different man than I was thirty days ago, and some money showed up that I wasn’t counting on. Do the work and see for yourself.
